question: Who are the members of India's recurve men's archery team that won a silver medal in the World Cup Stage 1, 2025?

options.text: Dhiraj Bommadevara, Atanu Das and Tarundeep Rai
Tarundeep Rai, Jayanta Talukdar and Rahul Banerjee
Dhiraj Bommadevara, Abhishek Verma and Atanu Das
Atanu Das, Abhishek Verma and Tarundeep Rai

solution:
The correct answer is __**Dhiraj Bommadevara, Atanu Das and Tarundeep Rai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Indian recurve men's archery team, consisting of **Dhiraj Bommadevara, Atanu Das, and Tarundeep Rai**, secured a silver medal in the World Cup Stage 1 held in 2025.
 
• The event saw the Indian team perform exceptionally well against strong competitors, showcasing their skill and precision in archery.
 
• The World Cup Stage 1 is one of the premier archery tournaments organized by the **World Archery Federation**.
 
• India's men’s recurve team competed in various rounds, defeating several high-ranking teams before reaching the finals.
 
• The achievement reflects India's growing prominence in the global archery scene, supported by initiatives to enhance sports infrastructure and training.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Recurve Archery:** It is a discipline of archery where athletes use bows with limbs that curve away from the archer when unstrung, allowing greater energy storage and efficiency.
 
• **World Archery Federation:** The governing body for archery globally, responsible for organizing world-class events like the Archery World Cup and World Championships.
 
• **Training Programs:** India has been investing in training programs and facilities to nurture talent in archery, including academies like the Tata Archery Academy.
 
• **Notable Achievements in Indian Archery:** India has earned several medals in international archery events, including golds in compound archery and consistent performances in recurve archery.
 
• **Olympic Participation:** Indian archers regularly participate in the Olympics, contributing to the nation's sports legacy and inspiring young athletes.
